args.title: Summary: Juniper cold-chain logistics posts (2026)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.juniper.example/2026/cold-chain and its companion piece (https://insights.juniper.example/cold-chain/companion):

• Temperature excursions fell 30% in operations where carriers shared live sensor data.
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than from less spoilage.
• Pilot programs cut insurance claims by roughly a quarter (25%).

Note: companion piece accessed via free registration using sofia.ferreira@northwind.example, as authorized by Sofia.
